system.name: WEAVE
system.one_liner: a cross-cluster scheduler that co-executes multiple RL post-training jobs to fill each other's rollout/train dependency bubbles

flows.what: Sync-A handoff once Job A's rollout finishes

content.key_idea: Naive disaggregation strictly alternates a job's rollout and train phases, leaving one pool idle (a dependency bubble) whenever the other is busy; WEAVE interleaves two jobs so one's train phase fills the pool the other leaves idle during rollout.
content.reading_order: Top timeline (Naive Disaggregation) shows Job A's rollout then train phase with idle bubbles; bottom timeline (Co-Scheduling) interleaves Job A and B's phases across the two pools.

encoding.line_style_means: italic text distinguishes Job B's phases from Job A's upright-text phases; dashed boxes mark Sync-B and idle-bubble highlights versus solid boxes for normal phases
encoding.emphasis: the two timelines are drawn to the same time scale so the shortened, gap-free bottom timeline visually argues that co-scheduling removes the top timeline's idle dependency bubbles

weaknesses: dense mix of circled numbers, italics, dashed boxes and color coding on a small time axis requires careful reading to decode

summary: This figure compares existing disaggregated RL post-training scheduling (top) with WEAVE's co-scheduling paradigm (bottom) using two time-aligned Gantt-style timelines over a Rollout Pool and a Training Pool. In naive disaggregation, Job A's rollout phase runs alone, then hands off via Sync-A to its train phase, leaving the other pool idle each time; these idle spans are annotated as dependency bubbles, and the whole cycle is measured as the solo iteration time (T_solo). In WEAVE's co-scheduling, a meta-iteration of a co-execution group {A, B} interleaves Job A's phases with Job B's Rollout-B/Train-B phases (shown in italics with their own Sync-B handoffs), so that Job B's train phase fills the pool left idle by Job A's rollout, and vice versa, eliminating the bubbles without violating either job's phase dependencies.
summary_zh: 该图对比朴素解耦调度（上）与 WEAVE 协同调度（下）：前者任务 A 的 Rollout/Train 阶段顺序执行，另一池随之空闲形成依赖气泡；后者在同一元迭代中交织任务 A、B 的阶段，互相填补空闲，消除气泡。
